title: Playtest, Branch Simulation, State Snapshot & Reset Workspace
objective: Extend the prepared MAS Adventure workspace with bounded playtest, branch-simulation, state-snapshot and reset-workspace preparation over MAS-01..16 while preserving canonical live Session, Action/Event and runtime owner authority and keeping simulation/snapshot/reset outputs distinct from live truth.

scope.purpose: Represent bounded Adventure playtest, branch-simulation, state-snapshot and reset workspace structures inside MAS without treating simulated or reset state as canonical live Session or Action/Event truth.
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS workspace can deterministically prepare and inspect bounded playtest/branch simulation with snapshot/reset semantics over completed MAS foundations while preserving canonical owner/runtime authority and never treating simulated state, snapshots or resets as live occurrences.

selection_boundaries: MAS-01 through MAS-16 remain completed foundations and were not reopened.

P9-06-007 SessionCheckpoint/AuthoritativeSessionPort retained canonical checkpoint/restore authority; P9-06-019 retained checksum/revision-safe restoration semantics; P9-06-016 and realtime-session retained live Session command/revision/event authority; Action/Event and runtime owners retained occurrence and mutation truth.

Prepared Playtest, Branch Simulation, State Snapshot and Reset Workspace structures never proved a canonical checkpoint was created, a Session restored or reset, a revision advanced, runtime state changed or an Action/Event occurred.
MAS-17 consumed explicit MAS-16 prepared references plus validated SessionCheckpoint, Session, ActionEvent and Runtime owner bindings; unresolved and owner-domain-mismatched references fail closed.
Production code remained frozen after minimum GREEN 9bef6fb93be6c203e0d4e2bde91d135e1a7e0dbf; the proof layer added governance/compliance/verifier surfaces only.
Existing MAS validation family remained active; no family transition occurred in MAS-17.
ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json was reconsulted after MAS-17, including current MSLR/MSWI planning; no new cross-program rotation is unlocked, so MAS-18 is selected_not_started.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MAS-19+ and SMB-08 were not implemented by this tranche.
next_action: MAS-17 is closed. MAS-18 is selected_not_started after ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.
